doc: Monster script for the elemental flying enemies, monster kinds 76 to 95 in groups of four: fire (76-79), ice (80-83), thunder (84-87), water (88-91) and wind (92-95). They hover near the ground, swoop at the player with a melee attack and shoot an elemental ball of their own element; the kind check selects which effect is loaded and spawned. Behaviour changes with distance and with rage hits left.
